findings.location: Paragraph: “You can just have your playhouse.” (source.html near: "She picked up her shopping bag and put her sandwich and cookie bags into it. She threw her apple core to the dogs and started for the house.")
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the translated sentence with a closer, neutral rendering that preserves the original tone and meaning without adding negativity or changing nuance. Suggested replacement (preserving paragraph structure): «Вы можете просто оставить себе домик для игр.»
Fix agreement in Russian: change «Ваш домик — остаётся ваш проблемой.» to «Ваш домик — остаётся вашей проблемой.» or better to the suggested neutral rendering above.

findings.location: Paragraph: "Resolutely, she walked out of the pasture to find Asher and the girls."
findings.source_quote: "Resolutely, she walked out of the pasture to find Asher and the girls."
findings.suggested_fix: The translation adds an explicit motive (“решив помочь”) that is an interpretive expansion. For closer fidelity, render without adding motive, e.g. replace «Полностью решив помочь, она вышла на луг в поисках Эшера и девочек.» with «Решительно она вышла на луг, чтобы найти Эшера и девочек.»
findings.translation_quote: «Полностью решив помочь, она вышла на луг в поисках Эшера и девочек.»
